observedChanges: Under the same daylight proxy environment, the v0.8 hood has softer broad specular bands and less uniform high gloss.
The final character shoulder silhouette slopes from the collar and no longer projects as separate high spherical caps.
Neck and jaw now overlap continuously; the protruding elbow sphere was removed.
Standing and articulated walking images do not show an exposed void at the shoulder, neck or upper forearm.
remainingLimitations: Characters retain stylized procedural facial anatomy, shared clothing shapes and angular lapels.
A faint articulation line remains on the bent sleeve; this is a segmented rigid-joint model rather than a skinned scanned asset.
Surface detail is procedural and filtered at distance; no scanned textures or skin subsurface scattering are present.
These fixtures do not establish in-game performance, whole-city art acceptance or AAA quality.
evidence: metadata.json records the final model/surface source hashes, cameras and lighting.
